transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I sign off on the annex room assignments and the controls for the equipment-issue desk and the protected medical-records desk, I need to hear from facilities and signal. Are there any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements we need to address before either desk opens tomorrow morning? Both the East and West rooms can be made ready, so let's hear what we need to factor in.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I need to flag a floor-load concern before we assign rooms. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified this morning that East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. That means the equipment-issue desk with its stocked cabinet cannot safely go in East Room — it exceeds the rating by 300 kilograms. West Room can handle it. The floor-load note hasn't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, which is why this hasn't come up before now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I have a critical infrastructure requirement to flag. The protected medical-records desk can connect to the required isolated network only through the fiber patch panel in East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection from 0900 to 1000 tomorrow — I received the booking confirmation this morning, but it hasn't been added to the annex opening checklist yet. This means the protected medical-records desk needs to go in East Room, which is the only room with the fiber patch panel that can provide the isolated network connection it requires.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Add the floor-load note to the relocation worksheet so the equipment-issue desk placement in West Room is documented.
Add the fiber patch panel certification to the annex opening checklist for the 0900-1000 window tomorrow.
